method: Deep-research historical replay built from the already-frozen Q1 event set. Company evidence is restricted to documents provably available by each memo cutoff; current model weights may still encode later 2026 outcomes.
caveats: Live search was performed in September 2026; only documents available by each historical cutoff are admitted to memo evidence.
Current model weights and search snippets can contain post-cutoff knowledge, so this run remains exploratory_contaminated.
No realized Q1-2026 selected-stock returns were opened before the memos and matched controls were frozen.
Use the run to find general process failures; never claim clean predictive alpha.
